matches.rationale: No finding addresses Equation (3)'s unimodal/cross-modal decomposition or its concatenation/indexing issues; the only finding concerns the attention scaling equations (5)-(6)/(14)-(15).

The finding identifies exactly the sqrt(N_t) vs sqrt(d) scaling conflict in the cross-attention equations, i.e., the same mathematical inconsistency as gt_id 2, even though it frames the main text (d) as correct and the appendix (N_t) as wrong rather than vice versa — per R2/R3 this still counts as detection of the same defect.
No finding discusses Equation (13)'s inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector for text tokens.
